common.tagline: Feeds, messages, and parties for gamers in one place

method.title: Sign up
method.description: You must be 14 or older. You can connect more login methods later in login methods.
method.oauthFailedTitle: Google or Kakao sign-in did not complete

email.title: Sign up with email
email.passwordHint: 8-20 characters with at least one letter and one number
email.providerTitle: Google or Kakao did not share a verified email
email.providerBody: Verify your email to continue. If an account already uses this email, Google or Kakao will be connected to it.
email.invalidPassword: Use 8-20 characters with at least one letter and one number.
email.existingBody: Log in with this email or reset your password.
email.failedTitle: We couldn't send the verification email

sent.title: Verification email sent
sent.body: Open the link sent to {email} within {minutes} minutes. The link works only once.
sent.spam: If you don't see it, check your spam folder.
sent.noEmail: Enter your email again to receive a verification email.
sent.failedTitle: We couldn't send the verification email

phone.title: Verify your identity
phone.description: Used to block sign-ups under 14 and to allow one account per person. Other members can't see it.
phone.underAge: You must be 14 or older to sign up.
phone.codeMismatch: The code is incorrect. {count} attempts left
phone.linkInvalidBody: Links are valid for {minutes} minutes. Request a new verification email.
phone.smsFailedTitle: We couldn't send the verification text
phone.smsFailedBody: Try again shortly. You can request a new code once every {seconds} seconds, up to {limit} times a day.
phone.activeTitle: This phone number is already registered
phone.activeBody: This number is verified on {email}. Log in to that account and connect this method in Settings > Login methods.
phone.suspendedTitle: This number belongs to a suspended account
phone.suspendedBody: {email} is suspended. Log in to that account after the suspension ends.
phone.withdrawnTitle: This number belongs to a recently withdrawn account
phone.withdrawnBody: Contact support to restore it, or sign up again after the waiting period.
phone.restrictedTitle: You can't sign up with this number right now
phone.restrictedBody: This number can't be used to sign up again for a set period.
phone.emailSuspendedTitle: This email belongs to a suspended account
phone.emailSuspendedBody: Log in to that account after the suspension ends. Your email was not connected.
phone.emailWithdrawnTitle: This email belongs to a recently withdrawn account
phone.emailWithdrawnBody: Contact support to restore it, or sign up again after the waiting period.

profile.title: Nickname and consent
profile.invalidNickname: Use 2-12 characters: Korean, letters, numbers, or underscore (_).
profile.privacy: [Required] Collection and use of personal information
profile.privacyBirthDate: Date of birth: blocking sign-ups under 14
profile.privacyPhone: Phone number: one account per person via text verification
profile.privacyRetention: Retention: deleted 30 days after withdrawal. A check value of the phone number is kept 30 more days to limit re-sign-up
